dependency_scope: All new training states and raw observations retained; exact previous Git archive members bind original and augmented inputs and reference fits.

limits: No gradient replay or intermediate-weight reconstruction from hashes.
Cached source vectors and prior architecture arithmetic reuse authenticated predecessor evidence.
Boundary CE labels supervise training only; exact generated fidelity remains the selection gate.
Exposed validation is not a fresh holdout; no native/Lake execution or qualification.

joint_binding_analysis.interpretation: Order/both arms have trained on these exact training-only permutations; original validation is separate. Correct marginal values or pair counts do not establish complete ordered reconstruction.

limitations: Previously exposed authored development corpus; original validation preserved, not a fresh holdout.
Augmentation preserves reference token/update budgets; boundary training adds extra computation and labels.
Raw scalar scores, generated relational binding, duplicate counts, EOS and whole-document exactness are distinct.
Generated-prefix stopping labels enter training losses only; inference has no target count or forced closure.
No global optimum, native-family qualification, Lake build, production promotion or Constitution formalization is established.
outcome: No accepted reconstruction improvement: every fit selected epoch 0 and every final validation panel remained 0/48 exact. Stopping, syntax and rule coverage changed unevenly; fewer duplicates can accompany missing-rule collapse. Boundary supervision added substantial computation without passing the unchanged gates.
reproducibility_scope: Artifact closure and original-path mapping; Python/host libraries and hardware are external. Encoder not executed in this training experiment.

resources.child_time_scope: includes monitoring and accounting before reap; excludes initial admission

telemetry.workload: Cached-embedding private decoder training; boundary-supervised arms add measured source-only generation and prefix replay, so matched reference tokens do not imply matched compute.

test_scope: Fresh frozen 42-file suite; historical receipts are not recounted.
